Context: 2. Determination of Relative Seniority

- 2.4. Actual fear of Appointment.The seniority of direct recruits and promotees is determined based on the year they are appointed or formally issued an appointment order and joined the cadre.
- 2.5. Joining in Subsequent Years.If the appointment year is different from the recruitment year, the seniority of the appointees is assigned according to the year of actual joining, and they do not receive seniority from earlier years.
